name: Microsoft
description: Sign in with a Microsoft account (Entra ID) and sync meetings with Outlook

page.title: Microsoft
page.description: Sign in with Microsoft Entra ID and sync your meetings with the Outlook calendar.

steps: In the Microsoft Entra ID portal, under "App registrations", register a new application.
Under "Authentication", add the "Web" platform with the callback URL above.
Under "Certificates & secrets", create a client secret and copy its value (not its ID) here, together with the application (client) ID.
Under "API permissions", add the delegated Microsoft Graph permissions openid, email, profile, offline_access and Calendars.ReadWrite.
Optional: under "Token configuration", add the xms_edov optional claim; without it, sign-in only accepts accounts of the configured domains.
Fill in the tenant (directory ID) to accept only your company.

tenant.label: Tenant
tenant.help: Directory ID (GUID) to accept only your company, or organizations for any work account

client_id.label: Client ID
client_id.help: Identifier of the application registered at the provider

client_secret.label: Client secret
client_secret.help: Application secret; stored encrypted and never shown again

domains.label: E-mail domains
domains.help: Domains that sign in through single sign-on, separated by commas (e.g. company.com). Empty = the button does not show on the login screen

require_sso.label: Require single sign-on
require_sso.help: Refuses password login for e-mails of these domains

meeting_type.label: Meeting activity type
meeting_type.help: Key of the activity type used for synced meetings (default: meeting)

import_scope.label: Calendar events imported
import_scope.help: By default only events with a participant who is already a CRM contact are imported
